summary: Verified Header overlap bug fix across 7 viewport widths (375, 768, 1024, 1280, 1440, 1600, 1920). The fix (gap-4 on header row, flex-shrink-0 on logo, lg:->xl: breakpoint) works correctly. No overlap between logo and nav at any desktop width; all 12 top-level nav items + ThemeToggle render inline. Mobile hamburger correctly takes over at <1280px. Dropdowns (About, Resource Directory) still open on hover.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx (~207 lines) is fine size-wise but consider extracting DesktopNav and MobileNav subcomponents if nav grows further. With 12 top-level items already, the desktop bar is tight at 1280px (item spacing is space-x-0.5 with text-[13px]); any additional item will require raising the breakpoint again or truncating labels.

At 1280px viewport, the entire desktop nav width is 1026px vs logo width ~195px, using nearly the full 1216px content area (gap 16px). This is close to the edge; a longer future label could re-trigger wrap/overlap. Consider a runtime overflow guard or media-query based label shortening.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header overlap bug is fully fixed. gap-4 + flex-shrink-0 provide a stable 16px gap between logo and nav across all desktop widths (1280-1920). The lg:->xl: breakpoint switch means users on 1024-1279px laptops now see the hamburger menu instead of a cramped desktop nav. All existing data-testids (mobile-menu-toggle, nav-dropdown-about, nav-dropdown-menu-about, nav-dropdown-resource-directory, nav-dropdown-menu-resource-directory) are intact and working. No regressions detected.
rca of the issue: Original bug: with 10 nav items + Donate + ThemeToggle at the lg (>=1024px) breakpoint, the desktop nav exceeded available width in the flex row (justify-between). Since the logo used no shrink control and had no explicit gap to the nav, the nav overflowed and visually overlapped the logo's text (tryHimandsee). Fix applied by main agent: (a) added gap-4 to the header row div to guarantee 16px min separation between logo and nav; (b) added flex-shrink-0 to the logo Link so it never shrinks under pressure; (c) raised the mobile-menu breakpoint from lg (1024) to xl (1280) so any viewport < 1280 shows the hamburger instead of trying to render 12 items inline. Verified visually and via bounding-rect measurements at 1280/1440/1600/1920 (all show 16px gap, no overlap).
